Reproducible analysis and publication tables and figure for the BMT age and ISS correspondence

Andrew J. Portuguese, Dianna S. Howard, Rahul Banerjee

October 03, 2026

1 Purpose and use

This report generates Main Table 1, Supplementary Tables 1–6, and Supplementary Figure 1 for the BMT age-and-ISS correspondence, with expandable code for each display.

The default render reruns the analysis using independently obtained CIBMTR P-5544/MM19-01 data.

2 Shared analysis code

The following sections expose the code that prepares the cohort and computes the results. Publication-specific assembly and display code appears beside each table or figure.

2.1 Data preparation and descriptive summaries

Show shared generating code 
# ---- analysis-constants ----
recode_factor <- function(x, values, labels) factor(x, levels = values, labels = labels)
age_labels <- c('<65', '\u226565')
age_colors <- setNames(c('#0072B2', '#D55E00'), age_labels)
# ---- cohort-and-endpoints ----
# Recoding is matched to the established public analysis; unknown values remain missing.
raw <- read_sas(source_file)
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 1135L, !anyDuplicated(raw$dcrid), !anyNA(raw$age))
data <- raw |>
  mutate(age_group = factor(ifelse(age < 65, age_labels[1], age_labels[2]), levels = age_labels),
         ISS = recode_factor(iss, 1:3, c('I', 'II', 'III')),
         sex_f = recode_factor(sex, 1:2, c('Male', 'Female')),
         race_f = recode_factor(racegp, c(1, 2, 88), c('White', 'Black or African American', 'Other')),
         kps_f = recode_factor(kpr, 1:2, c('90\u2013100', '<90')),
         hctci_f = factor(case_when(adjhctci == 0 ~ '0', adjhctci %in% 1:2 ~ '1\u20132',
                                   adjhctci %in% 3:5 ~ '\u22653'), levels = c('0', '1\u20132', '\u22653')),
         cyto_f = recode_factor(cytonomod, c(0, 1, 2), c('Standard risk', 'Standard risk', 'High risk')),
         subtype_f = recode_factor(immunogp, 1:4, c('IgG', 'IgA', 'Light chain', 'Nonsecretory/other')),
         induction_f = recode_factor(chemo, 2:3, c('VRD', 'VCD')),
         egfr_f = recode_factor(GFRgpmod, 1:2, c('\u226560', '<60')),
         egfr_dx_f = recode_factor(GFRdxgpmod, 1:2, c('\u226560', '<60')),
         response_f = recode_factor(myestaprgp, 1:3, c('sCR/CR', 'VGPR', 'PR')),
         melphalan_f = recode_factor(lpamgp, 1:2, c('140', '200')),
         maintenance_f = recode_factor(planrxhimod, 0:1, c('No', 'Yes')),
         os_ok = is.finite(intxsurv) & intxsurv >= 0 & dead %in% 0:1,
         pfs_ok = is.finite(intxrel) & intxrel >= 0 & dfs %in% 0:1,
         os_available_f = factor(ifelse(os_ok, 'Available', 'Unavailable'), levels = c('Available', 'Unavailable')),
         pfs_available_f = factor(ifelse(pfs_ok, 'Available', 'Unavailable'), levels = c('Available', 'Unavailable')),
         os_event_f = recode_factor(dead, 0:1, c('No death', 'Death')),
         pfs_event_f = recode_factor(dfs, 0:1, c('No progression/death', 'Progression/death')))
data$cyto_f <- factor(as.character(data$cyto_f), levels = c('Standard risk', 'High risk'))
analytic <- data |> filter(!is.na(ISS), is.finite(age))
adjustments <- c('sex_f', 'kps_f', 'hctci_f', 'cyto_f', 'induction_f', 'egfr_f')
main_vars <- c('age_group', 'ISS', adjustments)
extra_vars <- c('response_f', 'melphalan_f')
analytic$main_complete <- complete.cases(analytic[, c(main_vars, 'dccn')])
analytic$expanded_complete <- complete.cases(analytic[, c(main_vars, extra_vars, 'dccn')])
endpoints <- list(OS = list(time = 'intxsurv', event = 'dead', ok = 'os_ok'),
                  PFS = list(time = 'intxrel', event = 'dfs', ok = 'pfs_ok'))
endpoint_data <- lapply(endpoints, function(e) analytic |> filter(.data[[e$ok]]))
model_data <- lapply(endpoint_data, function(d) d |> filter(main_complete))
expanded_data <- lapply(endpoint_data, function(d) d |> filter(expanded_complete))
counts <- analytic |> count(ISS, age_group, name = 'n')
write_table(counts, 'age_iss_counts')

# ---- descriptive-summaries ----
# Aggregate descriptive tables, with nonmissing denominators and explicit missing rows.
descriptive_vars <- c('age', 'sex_f', 'race_f', 'kps_f', 'hctci_f', 'cyto_f', 'subtype_f',
                      'induction_f', 'egfr_dx_f', 'egfr_f', 'response_f', 'melphalan_f', 'maintenance_f',
                      'os_available_f', 'pfs_available_f', 'os_event_f', 'pfs_event_f')
describe <- function(d, group_cols, vars) {
  keys <- apply(as.data.frame(lapply(d[, group_cols, drop = FALSE], as.character)), 1, paste, collapse = ' | ')
  rows <- list()
  for (g in unique(keys)) {
    sub <- d[keys == g, , drop = FALSE]
    for (v in vars) {
      x <- sub[[v]]; nonmiss <- sum(!is.na(x)); missing <- sum(is.na(x))
      if (v == 'age') {
        q <- quantile(x, c(.25, .5, .75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(group = g, variable = v, level = 'Continuous',
          group_n = nrow(sub), nonmissing_n = nonmiss, n = nonmiss, percent = NA_real_,
          median = q[2], q1 = q[1], q3 = q[3], minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE), maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        for (lev in levels(x)) {
          nn <- sum(as.character(x) == lev, na.rm = TRUE)
          rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(group = g, variable = v, level = lev,
            group_n = nrow(sub), nonmissing_n = nonmiss, n = nn,
            percent = if (nonmiss) 100 * nn / nonmiss else NA_real_, median = NA_real_, q1 = NA_real_,
            q3 = NA_real_, minimum = NA_real_, maximum = NA_real_)
        }
      }
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(group = g, variable = v, level = 'Missing',
        group_n = nrow(sub), nonmissing_n = nonmiss, n = missing, percent = 100 * missing / nrow(sub),
        median = NA_real_, q1 = NA_real_, q3 = NA_real_, minimum = NA_real_, maximum = NA_real_)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}
write_table(describe(analytic, 'age_group', c('age', 'ISS', setdiff(descriptive_vars, 'age'))), 'baseline_by_age')
write_table(describe(analytic, c('ISS', 'age_group'), descriptive_vars), 'baseline_by_age_and_iss')

write_table(describe(data, c('iss_observed', 'age_group'), descriptive_vars), 'known_vs_missing_iss_by_age')
inclusion_tables <- list(); missing_reason_rows <- list()
for (ep in names(endpoints)) {

  d$model_inclusion <- ifelse(!d[[endpoints[[ep]]$ok]], 'Endpoint unavailable',
                             ifelse(d$main_complete, 'Included in primary model', 'Covariate incomplete'))

write_table(bind_rows(inclusion_tables), 'primary_model_included_vs_excluded')
write_table(bind_rows(missing_reason_rows), 'overlapping_covariate_missingness')
# Compact display-ready aggregate exports support readable supplemental Word tables.
compact_descriptive <- function(table) {
  labels <- unique(table[, c('variable', 'level')]); groups <- unique(table$group)
  labels$label <- ifelse(labels$level == 'Continuous', labels$variable, paste(labels$variable, labels$level, sep = ': '))
  for (g in groups) {
    ss <- table[table$group == g, ]
    val <- character(nrow(labels))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(labels))) {
      r <- ss[ss$variable == labels$variable[i] & ss$level == labels$level[i], ]
      if (!nrow(r)) { val[i] <- ''; next }
      val[i] <- if (r$level == 'Continuous') sprintf('%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]', r$median, r$q1, r$q3) else if (r$level == 'Missing')
        sprintf('%d', r$n) else sprintf('%d (%.1f%%)', r$n, r$percent)
    }
    labels[[g]] <- val
  }
  labels
}

write_table(compact_descriptive(describe(data, 'iss_observed', descriptive_vars)), 'supplement_iss_missingness_compact')

2.2 Survival estimates and follow-up

Show shared generating code 
# ---- kaplan-meier-and-followup ----
# Survival estimates and independent product-limit validation.
manual_km <- function(time, event, tau) {
  s <- 1
  for (t in sort(unique(time[event == 1 & time <= tau]))) s <- s * (1 - sum(time == t & event == 1) / sum(time >= t))
  s
}
survival_rows <- list(); km_checks <- list(); km_curves <- list(); km_censors <- list(); km_risks <- list()
for (ep in names(endpoints)) for (stage in levels(analytic$ISS)) for (ag in age_labels) {
  e <- endpoints[[ep]]; d <- endpoint_data[[ep]] |> filter(ISS == stage, age_group == ag)
  f <- survfit(Surv(d[[e$time]], d[[e$event]]) ~ 1, conf.type = 'log-log')
  z <- summary(f, times = c(12, 24, 36), extend = FALSE)
  stopifnot(length(z$time) == 3L, all(z$n.risk > 0))
  survival_rows[[length(survival_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, age_group = ag,
    n = nrow(d), events = sum(d[[e$event]]), month = z$time, survival = z$surv,
    lower = z$lower, upper = z$upper, se = z$std.err, n_risk = z$n.risk)
  independent <- vapply(z$time, function(t) manual_km(d[[e$time]], d[[e$event]], t), numeric(1))
  stopifnot(max(abs(independent - z$surv)) < 1e-12)
  km_checks[[length(km_checks) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, age_group = ag,
    month = z$time, package = z$surv, independent = independent, difference = z$surv - independent)
  key <- paste(ep, stage)
  km_curves[[length(km_curves) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, age_group = ag,
    time = c(0, f$time), survival = c(1, f$surv), lower = c(1, f$lower), upper = c(1, f$upper))
  km_censors[[length(km_censors) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, age_group = ag,
    time = f$time[f$n.censor > 0], survival = f$surv[f$n.censor > 0])
  km_risks[[length(km_risks) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, age_group = ag,
    month = c(0, 12, 24, 36), n_risk = vapply(c(0, 12, 24, 36), function(t) sum(d[[e$time]] >= t), integer(1)))
}
survival_estimates <- bind_rows(survival_rows)
write_table(survival_estimates, 'survival_estimates')
write_table(bind_rows(km_checks), 'independent_km_checks')
write_table(bind_rows(km_risks), 'survival_at_risk')
old_estimates <- read.csv(file.path(baseline_dir, 'survival_estimates.csv'))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(survival_estimates))) {
  r <- survival_estimates[i, ]; old <- old_estimates[old_estimates$endpoint == r$endpoint & old_estimates$ISS == r$ISS &
      old_estimates$age == r$age_group & old_estimates$month == r$month, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(old) == 1L, abs(r$survival - old$survival) < 1e-12,
            abs(r$lower - old$lower) < 1e-12, abs(r$upper - old$upper) < 1e-12)
}
pass('All 36 KM estimates/CIs match saved outputs; survival probabilities match an independent product-limit calculation.')
follow_row <- function(d, group) {
  f <- survfit(Surv(intxsurv, 1 - dead) ~ 1, data = d, conf.type = 'log-log')
  st <- summary(f)$table
  med <- unname(st['median'])
  stopifnot(manual_km(d$intxsurv, 1 - d$dead, med) <= .5 + 1e-10,
            manual_km(d$intxsurv, 1 - d$dead, max(d$intxsurv[d$intxsurv < med], 0)) >= .5 - 1e-10)
  data.frame(group = group, n = nrow(d), median = med, lower = unname(st['0.95LCL']), upper = unname(st['0.95UCL']))
}
followup <- bind_rows(follow_row(endpoint_data$OS, 'Overall'),
  lapply(age_labels, function(a) follow_row(endpoint_data$OS |> filter(age_group == a), paste('Age', a))),
  lapply(levels(analytic$ISS), function(s) bind_rows(lapply(age_labels, function(a)
    follow_row(endpoint_data$OS |> filter(ISS == s, age_group == a), paste('ISS', s, '\u00b7 Age', a))))))
write_table(followup, 'reverse_km_followup')
old_followup <- read.csv(file.path(baseline_dir, 'reverse_km_followup.csv'))
stopifnot(max(abs(followup$median - old_followup$median)) < 1e-12,
          max(abs(followup$lower - old_followup$lower)) < 1e-12,
          max(abs(followup$upper - old_followup$upper)) < 1e-12)
pass('All reverse-KM estimates/CIs match saved outputs and independently cross survival 0.5 with event status reversed.')
benchmark_rows <- list()
for (ep in names(endpoints)) for (reg in c(2, 3)) {
  e <- endpoints[[ep]]; d <- data |> filter(chemo == reg, .data[[e$ok]])
  f <- survfit(Surv(d[[e$time]], d[[e$event]]) ~ 1)
  obs <- if (ep == 'PFS') unname(summary(f)$table['median']) else summary(f, times = 60)$surv
  target <- if (ep == 'PFS') ifelse(reg == 2, 44.6, 34.1) else ifelse(reg == 2, .79, .60)
  ok <- abs(obs - target) < ifelse(ep == 'PFS', .1, .01)
  stopifnot(ok)
  benchmark_rows[[length(benchmark_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, regimen = ifelse(reg == 2, 'VRD', 'VCD'),
    metric = ifelse(ep == 'PFS', 'Median PFS months', '5-year OS probability'), observed = obs, published = target, pass = ok)
}
write_table(bind_rows(benchmark_rows), 'published_benchmarks')

2.3 Adjusted models and sensitivity comparisons

Show shared generating code 
# ---- cox-models-and-age-stage-contrasts ----
# Retained Cox hierarchy: primary categorical age x ISS and supporting binary-age models.
# Retained categorical models target the specified age-group comparison.
fits <- list(); fit_data <- list(); model_rows <- list(); coef_rows <- list(); covariance_rows <- list()
formula_for <- function(e, extra = character(), stage_model = FALSE) {
  rhs <- c(if (stage_model) 'age_group' else 'age_group * ISS', adjustments, extra)
  as.formula(paste0('Surv(', e$time, ',', e$event, ') ~ ', paste(rhs, collapse = ' + ')))
}
register_fit <- function(ep, kind, d, form, stage = 'All') {
  label <- paste(ep, kind, stage, sep = '__')
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(coxph(form, data = d, cluster = dccn, ties = 'efron', x = TRUE, model = TRUE),
                            warning = function(w) record_warning(w, label))
  b <- coef(fit); V <- vcov(fit)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(b)), all(is.finite(V)), all(diag(V) > 0),
            identical(rownames(V), names(b)), identical(colnames(V), names(b)),
            qr(V)$rank == length(b), fit$n == nrow(d))
  fits[[label]] <<- fit; fit_data[[label]] <<- d
  e <- endpoints[[ep]]
  model_rows[[length(model_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = kind, stage = stage,
    n = nrow(d), events = sum(d[[e$event]]), centers = length(unique(d$dccn)),
    coefficients = length(b), events_per_coefficient = sum(d[[e$event]]) / length(b),
    iterations = fit$iter, covariance_rank = qr(V)$rank, finite_coefficients = all(is.finite(b)))
  for (s in levels(analytic$ISS)) if (any(d$ISS == s)) {
    sub <- d[d$ISS == s, ]
    model_rows[[length(model_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = paste(kind, 'stage population'),
      stage = s, n = nrow(sub), events = sum(sub[[e$event]]), centers = length(unique(sub$dccn)),
      coefficients = NA_integer_, events_per_coefficient = NA_real_, iterations = NA_integer_,
      covariance_rank = NA_integer_, finite_coefficients = TRUE)
  }
  coef_rows[[length(coef_rows) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = kind, stage = stage,
    coefficient = names(b), beta = unname(b), robust_se = sqrt(diag(V)), hr = exp(unname(b)),
    lower = exp(unname(b) - 1.96 * sqrt(diag(V))), upper = exp(unname(b) + 1.96 * sqrt(diag(V))),
    p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(unname(b) / sqrt(diag(V)))))
  vv <- as.data.frame(as.table(V), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(vv) <- c('coefficient_row', 'coefficient_col', 'robust_covariance')
  vv$endpoint <- ep; vv$model <- kind; vv$stage <- stage
  covariance_rows[[length(covariance_rows) + 1L]] <<- vv
  label
}
primary_labels <- base_expanded_labels <- expanded_labels <- list()
stage_labels <- list()
for (ep in names(endpoints)) {
  e <- endpoints[[ep]]
  primary_labels[[ep]] <- register_fit(ep, 'Primary categorical interaction', model_data[[ep]], formula_for(e))
  base_expanded_labels[[ep]] <- register_fit(ep, 'Base on expanded complete cases', expanded_data[[ep]], formula_for(e))
  expanded_labels[[ep]] <- register_fit(ep, 'Response and melphalan adjusted', expanded_data[[ep]], formula_for(e, extra = extra_vars))
  for (s in levels(analytic$ISS)) stage_labels[[paste(ep, s)]] <- register_fit(ep, 'Separate-stage sensitivity',
    model_data[[ep]] |> filter(ISS == s), formula_for(e, stage_model = TRUE), stage = s)
}
write_table(bind_rows(model_rows), 'model_populations')
write_table(bind_rows(coef_rows), 'model_coefficients')
write_table(bind_rows(covariance_rows), 'model_robust_covariance')

contrast_checks <- list(); interaction_rows <- list()
interaction_name <- function(bnames, base, stage) {
  candidates <- c(paste0(base, ':ISS', stage), paste0('ISS', stage, ':', base))
  hit <- intersect(candidates, bnames)
  stopifnot(length(hit) == 1L)
  hit
}
get_contrasts <- function(label, ep, kind, stages = levels(analytic$ISS), stage_model = FALSE) {
  f <- fits[[label]]; d <- fit_data[[label]]; b <- coef(f); V <- vcov(f)
  base <- paste0('age_group', age_labels[2])
  stopifnot(base %in% names(b))
  result <- list()
  for (stage in stages) {
    L <- setNames(rep(0, length(b)), names(b)); L[base] <- 1
    if (!stage_model && stage != 'I') L[interaction_name(names(b), base, stage)] <- 1
    beta <- sum(L * b); variance <- drop(t(L) %*% V %*% L); se <- sqrt(variance)
    nd <- d[rep(1, 2), , drop = FALSE]
    nd$ISS <- factor(rep(stage, 2), levels = levels(analytic$ISS))
    nd$age_group <- factor(age_labels, levels = age_labels)
    mm <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(f)), data = nd, contrasts.arg = f$contrasts, xlev = f$xlevels)
    delta <- mm[2, names(b), drop = TRUE] - mm[1, names(b), drop = TRUE]
    independent_beta <- sum(delta * b)
    independent_variance <- drop(t(delta) %*% V %*% delta)
    stopifnot(max(abs(L - delta)) < 1e-12, abs(independent_beta - beta) < 1e-12,
              abs(independent_variance - variance) < 1e-12, is.finite(se), se > 0)
    contrast_checks[[length(contrast_checks) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = kind, ISS = stage,
      explicit_beta = beta, design_matrix_beta = independent_beta, explicit_variance = variance,
      design_matrix_variance = independent_variance, maximum_vector_difference = max(abs(L - delta)))
    sub <- d[d$ISS == stage, ]; e <- endpoints[[ep]]
    result[[stage]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = kind, ISS = stage, model_n = nrow(d),
      model_events = sum(d[[e$event]]), stage_model_n = nrow(sub), stage_model_events = sum(sub[[e$event]]),
      contrast = '\u226565 versus <65',
      beta = beta, robust_se = se, hr = exp(beta), lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se), upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
      p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(beta / se)))
  }
  bind_rows(result)
}
get_interaction <- function(label, ep, kind) {
  f <- fits[[label]]; b <- coef(f); V <- vcov(f)
  base <- paste0('age_group', age_labels[2])
  ii <- vapply(c('II', 'III'), function(s) interaction_name(names(b), base, s), character(1))
  bi <- b[ii]; Vi <- V[ii, ii, drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(qr(Vi)$rank == 2L)
  W <- drop(t(bi) %*% solve(Vi, bi))
  A <- matrix(0, 2, length(b), dimnames = list(c('II', 'III'), names(b)))
  A[1, ii[1]] <- 1; A[2, ii[2]] <- 1
  independent_W <- drop(t(A %*% b) %*% solve(A %*% V %*% t(A), A %*% b))
  stopifnot(abs(W - independent_W) < 1e-10)
  data.frame(endpoint = ep, model = kind, age_contrast = '\u226565 versus <65',
    n = f$n, events = f$nevent, df = 2L, covariance_rank = qr(Vi)$rank, wald_chisq = W,
    independent_wald_chisq = independent_W, p = pchisq(W, 2, lower.tail = FALSE))
}
primary_rows <- expanded_base_rows <- expanded_rows <- separate_rows <- list()
for (ep in names(endpoints)) {
  primary_rows[[ep]] <- get_contrasts(primary_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Primary categorical interaction')
  expanded_base_rows[[ep]] <- get_contrasts(base_expanded_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Base on expanded complete cases')
  expanded_rows[[ep]] <- get_contrasts(expanded_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Response and melphalan adjusted')
  for (s in levels(analytic$ISS)) separate_rows[[paste(ep, s)]] <- get_contrasts(stage_labels[[paste(ep, s)]],
    ep, 'Separate-stage sensitivity', stages = s, stage_model = TRUE)
  interaction_rows[[length(interaction_rows) + 1L]] <- get_interaction(primary_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Primary categorical interaction')
  interaction_rows[[length(interaction_rows) + 1L]] <- get_interaction(base_expanded_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Base on expanded complete cases')
  interaction_rows[[length(interaction_rows) + 1L]] <- get_interaction(expanded_labels[[ep]], ep, 'Response and melphalan adjusted')
}
primary <- bind_rows(primary_rows); expanded_base <- bind_rows(expanded_base_rows)
expanded <- bind_rows(expanded_rows); separate <- bind_rows(separate_rows)
interactions <- bind_rows(interaction_rows)
write_table(primary, 'primary_age_stage_contrasts')
write_table(bind_rows(expanded_base, expanded), 'response_melphalan_paired_sample_contrasts')
write_table(separate, 'separate_stage_sensitivity')
write_table(interactions, 'interaction_tests')
write_table(bind_rows(contrast_checks), 'independent_contrast_checks')
old_separate <- read.csv(file.path(baseline_dir, 'age_hazard_ratios.csv')) |> filter(analysis == 'Multivariable')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(separate))) {
  r <- separate[i, ]; old <- old_separate |> filter(endpoint == r$endpoint, ISS == r$ISS)
  stopifnot(nrow(old) == 1L, max(abs(as.numeric(r[, c('hr', 'lower', 'upper', 'p')]) -
                                  as.numeric(old[, c('hr', 'lower', 'upper', 'p')]))) < 1e-10)
}
pass('All center-robust age contrasts agree with independent model-matrix contrasts, and joint interaction Wald tests agree with matrix restriction calculations.')
pass('All six existing separate-stage multivariable age HRs/CIs/p-values reproduced.')
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(table(model_data$OS$ISS)), as.integer(table(expanded_data$OS$ISS))),
          identical(as.integer(table(model_data$PFS$ISS)), as.integer(table(expanded_data$PFS$ISS))))
stopifnot(identical(model_data$OS$dcrid,expanded_data$OS$dcrid),identical(model_data$PFS$dcrid,expanded_data$PFS$dcrid))
pass('Response and melphalan dose are complete among primary complete cases; paired base/expanded models use identical samples.')
# ---- aggregate-proportional-hazards ----
# Grouped PH diagnostics describe the retained model hierarchy without selecting models by significance.
ph_rows <- list(); ph_summary_rows <- list()
for (label in names(fits)) {
  f <- fits[[label]]
  z <- withCallingHandlers(cox.zph(f, transform = 'km', terms = TRUE, singledf = FALSE),
                           warning = function(w) record_warning(w, label))
  tab <- as.data.frame(z$table); tab$term <- rownames(tab); rownames(tab) <- NULL
  tab$model_id <- label
  ph_rows[[label]] <- tab
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == 'GLOBAL']
  age_rows <- tab[grepl('age_group', tab$term), ]
  ph_summary_rows[[label]] <- data.frame(model_id = label, global_p = global_p,
    any_age_or_interaction_p_below_05 = any(age_rows$p < .05), any_term_p_below_05 = any(tab$p < .05))
  # Individual residual points remain in memory and are never exported.

}
ph_tests <- bind_rows(ph_rows); ph_summary <- bind_rows(ph_summary_rows)
write_table(ph_tests, 'proportional_hazards_tests')
write_table(ph_summary, 'proportional_hazards_summary')

2.4 Restricted mean survival time

Show shared generating code 
# ---- rmst2-function ----
# Package-based unadjusted RMST comparisons; no Cox models, figures, or bootstrap.
calculate_rmst2 <- function(endpoint_data, endpoints, tau = 24) {
  stopifnot(identical(tau, 24), requireNamespace('survRM2', quietly = TRUE))
  rows <- list()
  for (ep in names(endpoints)) for (stage in c('I', 'II', 'III')) {
    d <- endpoint_data[[ep]][as.character(endpoint_data[[ep]]$ISS) == stage, , drop = FALSE]
    e <- endpoints[[ep]]
    arm <- as.integer(d$age >= 65)
    stopifnot(all(arm %in% 0:1), all(table(factor(arm, levels = 0:1)) > 0),
              all(is.finite(d[[e$time]])), all(d[[e$time]] >= 0), all(d[[e$event]] %in% 0:1))
    fit <- survRM2::rmst2(time = d[[e$time]], status = d[[e$event]], arm = arm,
                         tau = tau, covariates = NULL, alpha = 0.05)
    contrast <- fit$unadjusted.result['RMST (arm=1)-(arm=0)', ]
    younger <- unname(fit$RMST.arm0$rmst['Est.'])
    older <- unname(fit$RMST.arm1$rmst['Est.'])
    stopifnot(fit$tau == tau, all(is.finite(c(younger, older, contrast))),
              abs(older - younger - contrast['Est.']) < 1e-10,
              contrast['lower .95'] <= contrast['Est.'], contrast['upper .95'] >= contrast['Est.'])
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      endpoint = ep, ISS = stage, horizon_months = tau,
      n_younger = sum(arm == 0), n_older = sum(arm == 1),
      events_younger = sum(d[[e$event]][arm == 0]), events_older = sum(d[[e$event]][arm == 1]),
      rmst_younger = younger, rmst_older = older,
      difference = unname(contrast['Est.']), lower = unname(contrast['lower .95']),
      upper = unname(contrast['upper .95']),
      package = 'survRM2', package_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion('survRM2')),
      estimator = 'Unadjusted Kaplan-Meier RMST',
      ci_method = 'Analytic normal interval using Greenwood plug-in variance',
      center_clustering_adjusted = FALSE)
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == 6L, sum(out$n_younger + out$n_older) == 1876L)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}
# ---- rmst2-comparisons ----
# Standard-package unadjusted RMST with native analytic intervals; no bootstrap.
centers <- sort(unique(analytic$dccn)); C <- length(centers)
rmst <- calculate_rmst2(endpoint_data, endpoints, tau = 24)
write_table(rmst, 'rmst_24_month_rmst2')
pass('Six unadjusted 24-month RMST comparisons use survRM2::rmst2 analytic 95% intervals; independent-patient assumption, no center adjustment.')

2.5 Publication formatting

Show shared generating code 
# ---- publication-formatters ----
read_aggregate <- function(name) read.csv(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, '.csv')), stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
fmt <- function(x, digits=2L) sprintf(paste0('%.', digits, 'f'), as.numeric(x))
fmt_ci <- function(r, point='hr', lower='lower', upper='upper', digits=2L) paste0(fmt(r[[point]],digits),' (',fmt(r[[lower]],digits),'–',fmt(r[[upper]],digits),')')
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(as.numeric(x)<.001,'<0.001',fmt(x,3))
one_row <- function(d, ...) {
  fields <- list(...); keep <- rep(TRUE,nrow(d))
  for (nm in names(fields)) keep <- keep & as.character(d[[nm]])==fields[[nm]]
  r <- d[keep,,drop=FALSE]; stopifnot(nrow(r)==1L); r
}
features <- list(c('age','Continuous'),c('sex_f','Male'),c('kps_f','<90'),c('hctci_f','0'),c('hctci_f','1–2'),c('hctci_f','≥3'),c('cyto_f','High risk'),c('induction_f','VRD'),c('egfr_dx_f','<60'),c('egfr_f','<60'),c('response_f','sCR/CR'),c('response_f','VGPR'),c('response_f','PR'),c('melphalan_f','140'),c('melphalan_f','200'),c('maintenance_f','Yes'),c('os_available_f','Available'),c('pfs_available_f','Available'))
endpoint_features <- list(c('os_event_f','Death'),c('pfs_event_f','Progression/death'))
descriptive_cells <- function(d, feature, groups) vapply(groups,function(g) {
 r <- one_row(d, group=g,variable=feature[1],level=feature[2]); m <- one_row(d,group=g,variable=feature[1],level='Missing')
 value <- if(feature[2]=='Continuous') paste0(fmt(r$median,1),' [',fmt(r$q1,1),'–',fmt(r$q3,1),']') else paste0(as.integer(r$n),' (',fmt(r$percent,1),')')
 if(m$n>0) value <- paste0(value,'; m=',as.integer(m$n)); value
},character(1))
fill_descriptive <- function(t,name,feature_list,groups,start) {
 d <- read_aggregate(name); stopifnot(length(t$rows)==length(feature_list))
 for(i in seq_along(feature_list)) t$rows[[i]][seq.int(start,length(t$rows[[i]]))] <- as.list(descriptive_cells(d,feature_list[[i]],groups))
 t$source_keys <- lapply(seq_along(feature_list),function(i) list(variable=feature_list[[i]][1],category=feature_list[[i]][2],groups=groups))
 t
}

  jp <- if(mi==2L) 'Not tested' else fmt_p(one_row(it,endpoint=ep,model=models[mi])$p)
  start <- if(ei==1L) 3L else 6L
  t$rows[[di]][start:(start+2L)] <- as.list(c(fmt_ci(r),paste0(r$stage_model_n,' / ',r$stage_model_events),jp))
 }
 di <- di+1L
}
t$source_keys <- lapply(seq_along(models),function(i) list(model=models[i],endpoints=c('OS','PFS'),stages=c('I','II','III')))
t$code_chunks <- c('supplementary-table-5-builder','display-supplementary-table-5')
publication_manifest$tables[[6]] <- t
# ---- display-supplementary-table-5 ----
render_publication_table(publication_manifest$tables[[6]])

3.7 Supplementary Table 6 Restricted mean survival through 24 months

Endpoint ISS RMST <65 months RMST ≥65 months Older minus younger months (95% CI)
OS I 23.53 23.52 -0.01 (-0.66–0.64)
II 23.38 22.80 -0.58 (-1.49–0.32)
III 22.57 22.54 -0.03 (-1.26–1.20)
PFS I 21.10 20.88 -0.22 (-1.69–1.24)
II 21.04 20.53 -0.51 (-2.08–1.06)
III 18.82 20.52 1.70 (-0.23–3.63)

Unadjusted RMST describes time alive (OS) or alive without progression (PFS) through 24 months. Positive differences favor older recipients descriptively. RMST estimates and analytic 95% CIs use survRM2::rmst2() with a fixed 24-month horizon. These intervals assume independent patients and do not account for transplant-center clustering. All six CIs include zero. These estimates do not adjust treatment-selection differences or confounding.

Show code for this table 
# ---- supplementary-table-6-builder ----
t <- publication_manifest$tables[[7]]; d <- read_aggregate('rmst_24_month_rmst2'); di <- 1L
for(ep in c('OS','PFS')) for(s in c('I','II','III')) {
 r <- one_row(d,endpoint=ep,ISS=s); t$rows[[di]] <- as.list(c(ep,s,fmt(r$rmst_younger),fmt(r$rmst_older),fmt_ci(r,'difference'))); di <- di+1L
}
stopifnot(all(d$lower<0 & d$upper>0))
t$source_keys <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)),function(i) as.list(d[i,c('endpoint','ISS','horizon_months')]))
t$code_chunks <- c('supplementary-table-6-builder','display-supplementary-table-6')
publication_manifest$tables[[7]] <- t

4 Figure

4.1 Supplementary Figure 1 Kaplan–Meier survival by age within ISS stage

Unadjusted OS (left column) and PFS (right column), with ISS I, II, and III from top to bottom and ages <65 and ≥65. Curves display 0–36 months; numbers at risk are shown at 0, 12, 24, and 36 months. Curves use endpoint-eligible populations, not the smaller complete-case model populations. Shaded bands show 95% CIs; crosses mark censoring. Numerical 24-month CIs are in Table 1. Interpret later estimates cautiously because older risk sets are small.

Show code for this figure 
# ---- kaplan-meier-figure ----
# Compact six-panel supplemental KM figure with uncertainty, censor marks, and risk tables.
curve_data <- bind_rows(km_curves); censor_data <- bind_rows(km_censors); risk_data <- bind_rows(km_risks)
# Plotmath renders the ≥ symbol in legends and at-risk labels with the standard
# R PDF device, without requiring an X11/Cairo installation or Unicode font.
for (plot_data in c('curve_data', 'censor_data', 'risk_data')) {
  plot_frame <- get(plot_data)
  plot_frame$age_group <- factor(plot_frame$age_group, levels = age_labels)
  assign(plot_data, plot_frame)
}
plot_age_colors <- setNames(unname(age_colors), age_labels)
plot_age_labels <- expression('<65', '' >= 65)
panels <- list()
for (s in levels(analytic$ISS)) for (ep in names(endpoints)) {
  cd <- curve_data |> filter(ISS == s, endpoint == ep)
  cc <- censor_data |> filter(ISS == s, endpoint == ep, time <= 36)
  rd <- risk_data |> filter(ISS == s, endpoint == ep)
  letter <- LETTERS[(match(s, levels(analytic$ISS)) - 1L) * 2L + match(ep, names(endpoints))]
  p <- ggplot(cd, aes(time, survival, color = age_group, fill = age_group)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = cd |> filter(is.finite(lower), is.finite(upper)), aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = .10, color = NA) +
    geom_step(linewidth = .7) + geom_point(data = cc, shape = 3, size = 1.3, stroke = .4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = plot_age_colors, labels = plot_age_labels) + scale_fill_manual(values = plot_age_colors, labels = plot_age_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 36), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36), expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .04))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100*x), '%')) +
    labs(title = paste0(letter, '  ', ep, ' - ISS ', s), x = NULL, y = 'Survival', color = 'Age at ASCT', fill = 'Age at ASCT') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = 'top', plot.title = element_text(face = 'bold'), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  risk <- ggplot(rd, aes(month, factor(age_group, levels = rev(age_labels)), label = n_risk, color = age_group)) +
    geom_text(size = 3.0) + scale_color_manual(values = plot_age_colors, guide = 'none') +
    scale_y_discrete(breaks = age_labels, labels = plot_age_labels) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36), limits = c(-1, 37)) +
    labs(x = 'Months after ASCT', y = 'At risk') + theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(), axis.text.y = element_text(), axis.title.x = element_text(),
          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8, margin = margin(r = 4)), plot.margin = margin(0, 8, 5, 8))
  panels[[paste(ep, s)]] <- p / risk + plot_layout(heights = c(4, .75))
}
grid <- wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(
  title = 'Overall and progression-free survival by age within ISS stage',
  subtitle = 'Public CIBMTR MM19-01 secondary analysis; curves through 36 months, shaded 95% CIs, crosses mark censoring',
  caption = 'OS is primary; PFS is secondary. Kaplan-Meier populations retain all endpoint-eligible recipients with known ISS. Adjusted comparisons are in the manuscript table.',
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold'), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
                plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0)))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, 'figures', 'supplemental_kaplan_meier.pdf'), grid, device = pdf, width = 12, height = 15, limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, 'figures', 'supplemental_kaplan_meier.png'), grid, width = 12, height = 15, dpi = 300, bg = 'white', limitsize = FALSE)
# ---- display-supplementary-figure-1 ----
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(run_dir,publication_manifest$figures[[1]]$path),rel_path=FALSE)
